title: Rick and the Artificial Sheep on the Rooftop

scene.description: Rick kneels on a rooftop, adjusting the control panel of his electric sheep while Barbour leans against the railing. Morning light filters through radioactive haze, illuminating the mechanical details of the sheep and Rick’s weathered appearance.
scene.action: Rick demonstrates the electric sheep’s control panel to skeptical neighbor Barbour
scene.mood: Somber tension between technological marvel and human skepticism

characters.name: Rick
characters.role: Owner of electric sheep, engaged in technical discussion
characters.face: Pale skin with dark circles, narrow eyes
characters.pose: Crouched to examine sheep’s control panel
clothing: Wrinkled gray jacket with faded patches
Dusty gray pants with torn knees

environment.lighting: Diffused morning light through radioactive haze
environment.architecture: Modernist apartment building with glass-and-steel facade

composition.focalPoint: Rick’s hand adjusting control panel interface
composition.foreground: Briefcase and half-eaten donut on concrete edge
composition.background: Industrial rooftop with faded blue tarps and rusted pipes

prompt: Photorealistic photograph of Rick, late 30s with a cut on his cheek, crouched on a rooftop examining an electric sheep with genuine fleece. The sheep's concealed control panel glows faintly blue, while Barbour, a weathered older man in a dark overcoat, stands nearby holding a newspaper. Morning light filters through radioactive haze, casting soft gray tones over the scene. Rick's phone displays diagnostic data in the foreground, with a briefcase and scattered debris on the concrete. The rooftop features industrial metal panels and rusted pipes under a diffused sky. Futuristic monochrome palette with rich details of dust, haze, and mechanical textures.
assumptions: Barbour’s appearance inferred as an older man with a weathered face and a trench coat to match the setting’s tone
Rooftop structure assumed to have industrial metal panels and a slight incline for practicality
Electric sheep’s control panel designed with minimalist futuristic interface elements
Radioactive haze visualized as thin, diffused particles floating in the air
